Kubernetes ecosystem (and the soft‐
ware itself) can be very confusing because it’s so capable—but it is both a strength
and a potential weakness.

Kubernetes provides the building blocks to build devel‐
oper platforms, while allowing organizations to take advantage of its pluggable
architecture to customize where it makes sense.

of maintaining a particular service in your Kubernetes cluster and thereby signifi‐
cantly reduce Day 2 operations costs.
